name: IKHCO x True Organics | Rainbow Guava | Live Rosin | 1g
description:
Introducing the Rainbow Guava 1g Live Rosin by Ice Kream Hash Co.—a vibrant burst of flavor and potency that promises to elevate your cannabis experience to new heights. Crafted with precision and passion, this premium solventless concentrate is a testament to our commitment to purity and sustainability, thanks to our proud partnership with True Organics. Together, we deliver clean, natural, and organic products that stay true to their roots, offering robust, earthy experiences to cannabis lovers everywhere.

Rainbow Guava is a delightful hybrid strain that marries the fruity allure of Rainbow Kush with the tropical zest of Guava. The result? A sensory symphony that dances on your palate and uplifts your spirit. With its striking aroma of sweet, tropical fruits and a subtle hint of earthiness, Rainbow Guava is your ticket to a refreshing escape from the mundane. Its balanced effects provide a euphoric and creative high, perfect for sparking inspiration or lifting your mood.

Ice Kream Hash Co. is renowned for delivering unparalleled quality in every gram, and our 1G Live Rosin is no exception. Made by pressing the finest 90u and 120u micron trichome heads, our rosin boasts the highest terpene content and the cleanest burn. Only the crème de la crème of hash meets our rigorous standards before being transformed into this top-tier extract.

Our meticulous post-processing method includes a long, slow cold cure of at least 7–10 days, allowing the rosin to develop its optimal texture and flavor. This process preserves terpenes, stabilizes consistency, and enhances the overall dabbing experience. Once cured, each batch is carefully whipped and packaged, ensuring that every jar delivers the smooth, flavorful, and ultra-potent quality that defines Ice Kream Hash Co.

For the ultimate experience, dab at the ideal temperature of 450–500°F to savor every terpene and enjoy a smooth, flavorful hit. To maintain its freshness and full-spectrum excellence, store your live rosin in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

Whether you're a seasoned cannabis connoisseur or a curious newcomer, Rainbow Guava promises a colorful journey into relaxation and creativity. Perfect for social gatherings or solo adventures, this strain is a must-try for anyone looking to explore the diverse world of cannabis. Experience the craftsmanship, taste the difference, and savor the superior quality of Ice Kream Hash Co. Live Rosin—where only the best hash makes the cut.
